fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, this pontoon is being sold through Knotty Oar Marina: the listing directs buyers to call the marina, offers marina winterization and storage as a purchase bonus, and was photographed in the marina's shop. That makes it dealer or marina stock rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Black panels on both sides look clean and glossy under the shop lights
Aluminum pontoon tubes look bright and even, with no visible waterline scum
Snap-on cover is fitted and looks clean
Outboard cowling looks glossy and clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crest 240 pontoon. The panels and tubes already look clean and glossy in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale detail or polish on a boat, we come to you, so let us know if you'd like a quote.
